sloka: वीक्षमाणस्ततस्तं वै वायसं समुदैक्षत ।नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ।। ५.३८.२७।।।।
transliteration: vīkṣamāṇastatastaṁ vai vāyasaṁ samudaikṣata ।nakhaiḥ sarudhiraistīkṣṇairmāmevābhimukhaṁ sthitam ।। 5.38.27।।।।

translations.english: 'Then looking around, you saw the crow facing me with sharp, bloodstained claws.
